summary: Read the root of a binary tree. At every node, exchange its left child with its right child, and do that exchange at every node so the shape is mirrored from left to right. Integers stored in the nodes keep their original values; only the child links change. Write the tree after every exchange is finished. A child that was missing stays missing, and no new integer is invented.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a level-order node count, using a dot for a missing child.
